properties.name: Malla Strict Nature Reserve
properties.description: Malla Strict Nature Reserve is Finland’s oldest strict nature reserve, located in Lapland near the borders with Sweden and Norway. It protects unique Arctic–alpine landscapes, rare plants, and dramatic fells shaped by harsh northern conditions.

properties.name: Sami Shop Heia
properties.description: Cool place to stop if you need the toilet or want to grab a drink, but the souvenirs are very pricey.

properties.name: Pikefossen

properties.name: Nordkapp Plateau
properties.description: You start at the top of Europe (almost). Sheer cliffs dropping 300+ meters into the Barents Sea. Go early morning or late evening to avoid bus traffic. If weather allows, walk away from the visitor center toward Knivskjellodden for solitude.

properties.name: Gjesværstappan
properties.description: Near Nordkapp. Take a boat trip if you can. Puffins, sea eagles, dramatic cliffs. It’s wild and loud — nature doesn’t whisper here.

properties.name: sukkertoppen Trail Headend/parking
properties.description: A steep climb to the Sukkertoppen rewards you with a unique 360-degree view over Bergsfjorden, Bergsøyene and Storhavet. Leaving the road the hike leads you through light birch forest. alltrails.com

properties.name: Sommerdalen Trail Headend/parking
properties.description: The hike to Sommardalen on the island of Senja is a fantastic choice for visitors seeking spectacular coastal views without committing to a strenuous summit climb. Starting from the village of Skaland, near the local grocery store and old town hall, the trail follows the lower section of the popular route toward Mount Husfjellet. alltrails.com

properties.name: Korouoma Canyon
properties.description: Even without doing the full hike, you can make quick stops at the canyon edges for dramatic views over the 30 km gorge.
